usage: starforge-live [-h]
                      {observe,actions,act,status,shadow-check,live-autopilot,live-observe}
                      ...

Live CLI for starforge_adapter (label: live-recorded)

positional arguments:
  {observe,actions,act,status,shadow-check,live-autopilot,live-observe}
    observe             fetch and print the live state
    actions             list actions legal right now
    act                 perform one live action (journaled)
    status              current session summary
    shadow-check        measure a transcript against the shadow sim
    live-autopilot      let a strategy play, under policy guardrails
    live-observe        serve the read-only observer dashboard

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: starforge-live actions [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json

usage: starforge-live act [-h] [--policy POLICY] [--json] action

positional arguments:
  action

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --policy POLICY  policy file (default: policy.json next to the CLI)
  --json

usage: starforge-live live-autopilot [-h] [--strategy {greedy,bfs,random}]
                                     [--strategy-file STRATEGY_FILE]
                                     [--seed SEED] [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                                     [--max-seconds MAX_SECONDS]
                                     [--target-score TARGET_SCORE]
                                     [--stall-limit STALL_LIMIT]
                                     [--bfs-max-nodes BFS_MAX_NODES]
                                     [--policy POLICY] [--dry-run] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strategy {greedy,bfs,random}
  --strategy-file STRATEGY_FILE
                        Python file defining choose(observe, legal_actions)
  --seed SEED
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
  --max-seconds MAX_SECONDS
  --target-score TARGET_SCORE
  --stall-limit STALL_LIMIT
  --bfs-max-nodes BFS_MAX_NODES
  --policy POLICY       policy file (default: policy.json next to the CLI)
  --dry-run             shadow simulation only: no live action is sent
  --json
